blocks.text: Sulfa drugs are the antibacterial sulfonamides such as penicillins and cephalosporins contain sulfur. The common drug omeprazole, used in GERD (Gastroesophageal reflux disease) contains sulfoxide group.
book_errors: sulfonamides such as penicillins and cephalosporins

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: The book's sentence groups penicillins and cephalosporins with the sulfonamides. Sulfa drugs (the antibacterial sulfonamides) contain sulfur; penicillins and cephalosporins are not sulfonamides but beta-lactam antibiotics, whose ring systems also contain sulfur.
